options.reason: Rows are individual invoice line items (StockCode x InvoiceNo) with quantity, unit price, date and customer; there is no plausible single outcome column, and the evident purpose of the extract is retail/customer analytics, so segment customers into static entity profiles (recency, frequency, monetary, basket diversity) rather than predict an invented label. InvoiceNo is a record/order key, and CustomerID is the source unit whose rows must stay together, so time columns are left empty because InvoiceDate is used only to aggregate static RFM features.
